city.title: City
city.description: City or area label shown in card.

guest_rating.title: Guest Rating (10)
guest_rating.description: Guest rating score displayed on card, usually out of 10.

guest_rating_out_of_five.title: Guest Rating (5)
guest_rating_out_of_five.description: Guest rating from analytics payload, usually out of 5.

review_count.title: Review Count
review_count.description: Total number of reviews shown for property.

review_label.title: Review Label
review_label.description: Guest score label such as Very Good or Wonderful.

nightly_price.title: Nightly Price
nightly_price.description: Nightly price line shown on listing card.

total_price.title: Total Price
total_price.description: Total stay price shown in card price option.

strikeout_price.title: Strikeout Price
strikeout_price.description: Previous price shown as strikeout when available.

taxes_and_fees_note.title: Taxes And Fees Note
taxes_and_fees_note.description: Price note related to taxes and fees.

member_price_available.title: Member Price Available
member_price_available.description: Whether listing indicates member pricing is available.

vacation_rental.title: Vacation Rental
vacation_rental.description: True when listing is a vacation rental product.

property_url.title: Property URL
property_url.description: Expedia hotel details URL for this listing.

region_id.title: Region ID
region_id.description: Search region ID used for request.

region_name.title: Region Name
region_name.description: Search region name used for request.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort mode used by Expedia search.

search_id.title: Search ID
search_id.description: Search identifier returned by Expedia listing API.

source_url.title: Source URL
source_url.description: API endpoint URL used to fetch listings.

operation_name.title: Operation Name
operation_name.description: GraphQL operation name used for extraction.

scraped_at.title: Scraped At
scraped_at.description: ISO timestamp when record was captured.
